text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, solving problems, and even making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of being programmed with exact rules. Deep learning goes further by using complex networks inspired by the human brain, allowing machines to process huge amounts of information and improve on their own. You likely use AI every day. Voice assistants, personalized movie suggestions, spam filters in email, and navigation apps all rely on these technologies to make our lives easier and faster.
